content: Pare abi go pageme agale madaa nana bi minasaalalo lagialo ya? Gore ali medalomame peme-rupa pepa kogono madaa bi waru meaminalo pi ya?
Dia-le naana bi meape pepa enaaliri nimi pimi. Go pepare naana lo robaa-para wia-le enaali raayome nimi pepa adoma yarepealimi.

Go pepare Keriso nipuna linaloma naame nimi piri-para mea ipisima. Apo pepa madaa nipumi pepa tyape naluma pepa-rupa kana madaa nalisa. Dia, pare ade abuna kagaa pirape Gote-na Holi Spirit-mi enaalinuna lo robaa-para pipa-rupa lisa.
Gore Keriso-me naa raba misa-pulu naame Gote madaa kone rulaoma go agale adaliminalo adaapu lu wima.
Ora naana gole go kogono mada napula pisima. Dia, Gote komeame puri gea rabu naame go kogono mada pema.

Gore Gote nipumi naa kone go nipu raapu pogalu pirape kogono maa gisa-pulu mada palima. Go pogalu pirape agalere pa rekena agale-daa dia pare Holi Spirit-miri nipuna pea. Gore rekena agaleme enaali komape kone katea pare Holi Spirit-miri enaalinu epe-rupa mapiraape kone katea.

Gote-me rekena agalere kana madaa luma gisa rabu Gote-na epe paana puri raapu ipisa. Go pisa-le Moses-na le-parare paa waru roaaya-pulu mo Israel enaalinumi nipuna le agaa-para na-adisimi. Go pisa pare werepere go epe paana puriri nadia lisa. Gore rekena agalena kogonore komape di-na puri mea ipisa.
Go pisa pare Holi Spirit-mi enaalinu ade abuna kagaa pirape puri go aaya-pulu go rekena agalena puri ma-oge yaaya.
Gore go rekena agale lisimide raburi koe kedaa mea ipisa pare go kogono madaa epe paana puri adisima. Go puma enaalinu ora epe-rupa mapiraape kogonore rekena agalena puri rabuaanaaya.
Go pea-le go kagaa agalena konena puriri abi ora waru epelea-pulu abalana lo robaana puriri ma-dia yalisa.
Gore go epe kogono madaa epe paana puri raapu koe kone ogepu aasa. Go pisa-pulu go ade abuna kagaa pirape kone madaa nipuna epe paana puri ora adaalupe su aaya.
Naame go ade abuna kagaa pirape muma piruaema-pulu naame agale puri paloma waru laketema.
Naame Moses-me pisa-au napima. Gore mo Israel enaalinumi Moses-na le agaana wi paa apeluma dialenalo nipu adisalimi-daa nipumi le agaana mamina kunimi kepisa.

Gore nimuna pu robaa-para rero pisa rabu pa naipisa pare abi page nimumi abalade rekena agale pa yarepema pitaa peme. Go peme-le mamina kuni eleme nimuna kone kepisa. Gore pa enaalimi raa namuma rubalimi pare Keriso raapu pitia rabu Gote-me go ele maa rubalia.
Gore abi page nimumi Moses-na agale yarepema pago pimi rabu mo mamina kuni eleme nimuna kone kepeabaaya.
Gore enaalinu kone naperekealimi rabu Gote-na buk-mi agale go-rupa lea: Moses Mudu Ali raapu pirisa enaalina mamina kunimi le agaa kepealia.
Go agale madaare Mudu Alimi Holi Spirit madaa agale lea. Go pea-pulu Mudu Ali-na Holi Spirit ali meda madaa pitiare go alina koe ele madaa keapalia rabu nipu epe-rupa pa piralia.

Go pea-le raayo medame naana le agaa kepeape ele nawia. Go pea-le ipa-para ele lewa lewa pala-rupa enaalinumi Mudu Ali-na epe puri naana le agaa-para mada adalimi. Ade abuna naame go epe paana puri muma piruaema rabu Mudu Ali-na kagaa kone wasupa adape nona pima. Go madaare Ali Mundu-ri Holi Spirit yaa-pulu nipumi go kagaa konena puri page naa go aaya.
